og.title: Groundbreaking Upgrade to SVG is Approaching: Linked Parameters Are Almost Here
og.description: “This feature will change everything” might be a bit of an exaggeration, but it, surely, will change a lot, both in #CSS and #SVG. In this post, I’ll report on what is happening right now with it, and why I think this is so exciting.
